title: Authorized chats, WebSocket and files
intent: Implement chat membership, message history, typed WebSocket events and authenticated object storage access on the owned backend.

requirements.title: Chats, WS and files
requirements.description: Provide member-authorized chats, ordered history pagination, message send/receive envelopes and authenticated upload/download through MinIO-compatible storage.

constraints: Stage 5 auth/app/router seam is consumed, not rewritten.
Membership checks are server-side on HTTP, WS and files.
File contract is explicit for RAG and bot consumers.
No frontend or course CI writes.
